events.title: Proposed ruling: no_action (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
The cancellation was made by the rider, so the fee can only be assessed through the rider-cancellation branch of NS-0, i.e. NS-4 for an on-demand booking [F2][NS-0]. The timeline shows the booking was accepted at 21:30:00 and cancelled at 21:33:20, i.e. 200 seconds (3 min 20 s) after matching [F1][F2]. NS-4 makes cancellations within 3 minutes free of charge, but any cancellation after that point attracts the $6.61 cancellation fee, so the threshold is crossed by 20 seconds [F2][NS-4].

The rider's stated reason is that the driver was still far away. The GPS record supports that the driver never entered the pickup radius (closest approach 2501 m at 21:31:20), and the timeline confirms no driver_arrived_at and no "I'm Here" tap [F1][F3][F4]. However, that matters only under the driver-initiated branch (NS-1/NS-2, NS-6), which is not the operative route here because the rider — not the driver — cancelled [F2][NS-0]. NS-4 expressly provides that the driver not having arrived yet is not a ground for free rider cancellation; the rider's remedy is a manual appeal under NS-7 [NS-4][NS-7]. The traffic and weather facts (Jalan Buroh band 3, no incidents, fair weather) concern the driver's routing obligations under RD-4 and do not create a rider-side cancellation waiver [F10][F11][F12][RD-4]. The fee charged, $6.61, matches the published cancellation fee, and no unpublished add-on appears, so nothing is refundable there either [F5][F6][FARE-1][NS-4].

The profile facts (rider 0 disputes/0 upheld; driver 1 dispute, 0 upheld) cannot decide the case on their own and in any event do not show the repeated-upheld condition needed for an account flag [F13][F14][RD-6]. The code trace settles NS-0 and NS-4 as pass, and the only permitted outcome is no_action; no amount is computed because there is no refundable item.

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked into your cancellation and the $6.61 fee stands. Cancellations made more than 3 minutes after you're matched with a driver are chargeable, and yours came about 20 seconds past that mark. Your driver not having arrived yet doesn't make the cancellation free — Ryde covers that situation only when the driver cancels. If you think the fee is wrong, you can request a waiver through RydeHELP within 30 days; waivers are issued as a Ryde voucher, not cash. Nothing changes on your account right now.

DRIVER: Your $6.61 cancellation fee is being paid to you. The rider cancelled roughly 20 seconds past the 3-minute window, so the fee applies even though you hadn't reached the pickup point. The amount is credited as a Ryde voucher, not cash. Nothing further is needed from you, and this dispute doesn't affect your account standing.
